name: relaunch-app
title: Relaunch App
description: Kill and relaunch any running macOS application instantly.
author: pratyush

commands.name: relaunch-app
commands.title: Relaunch App
commands.subtitle: Kill and Relaunch
commands.description: Choose a running app to kill and relaunch.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
